changes: Author Kāśīnātha: confidence lowered from high to medium because the written form 'kāiśātha' is corrupt; the identification rests on the known authorship of the Lagnacandrikā.
Notes: explained that 'alekhī chrīpatis' is the sandhi of alekhīt śrīpatiḥ.
Notes: the scribe's verse comes after the end-colophon, in the appended rohiṇīcakra section, so it may strictly refer only to that appendix. It most likely covers the whole copy.
Notes: added that Pauṣa śukla 2 of VS 1704 falls about Dec 1647 / Jan 1648 CE.

notes: The author's name is corrupt: 'kāiśātha' is taken as Kāśīnātha, the known author of the Lagnacandrikā. The year is a chronogram read right to left: veda 4, ambara 0, muni 7, indu 1, giving VS 1704 (agrees with the catalogue). Pauṣa śukla 2 of VS 1704 falls about Dec 1647 / Jan 1648 CE. 'alekhī chrīpatis' is the sandhi of alekhīt śrīpatiḥ. The scribe's verse comes after the end-colophon, in the appended rohiṇīcakra material, so strictly it may refer only to that appendix. It most likely dates the whole copy.
